title: Joab
lead: David's nephew and the commander of his army: brave, loyal to the throne, and ruthless. He kills Abner and Amasa, carries out the plot against Uriah, kills Absalom against orders, and finally backs Adonijah and is executed under Solomon.

sections.b: Joab is the son of Zeruiah, David's sister (1 Chronicles 2:16), with his brothers Abishai and Asahel. He leads David's men at Gibeon (2 Samuel 2:12–32), murders Abner to avenge Asahel (2 Samuel 3:22–30), wins command by being first up into Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 11:6), and leads the wars against Ammon and Aram (2 Samuel 10–12). He arranges Uriah's death at David's order (2 Samuel 11:14–25), brings Absalom home and later kills him (2 Samuel 14; 2 Samuel 18:14), kills Amasa (2 Samuel 20:8–10), and protests the census (2 Samuel 24:3). David's dying charge names him (1 Kings 2:5–6), and Benaiah kills him at the altar (1 Kings 2:28–34).
